reported_case: Tasks page shows calendar items but conflict panel says the week has no conflicts.
invariant: Conflict detection must run after the calendar cache used by detection has finished syncing.
acceptance_criteria: A detect result returned before calendar sync does not remain authoritative.
Calendar sync completion triggers a second detect for the same week.
Changing the viewed week triggers detection against the new cache window.
Existing conflict classification and resolution behavior remain unchanged.
counterexamples: A week with genuinely no conflicts remains empty after the post-sync detect.
Calendar sync failure does not fabricate a conflict.
